obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy = holder["center"][0], holder["center"][1]
table_z = obs["table_z"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# Select a candidate around height 0.08 - 0.09 m to safely grip the leaning pen above container rim
candidates = grasp_candidates("cyan_pen")
valid_cands = [c for c in candidates if c["hand_clear"] and c.get("fits_open_fingers", True)]

# Prefer candidate closest to height 0.085 m
chosen = min(valid_cands, key=lambda c: abs(c.get("height", 0.1) - 0.085))
chosen["height"] = 0.085

res = grasp(chosen)
if not res["holding_something"]:
    # Fallback to geometry candidate adjusted to 0.085 m
    for c in candidates:
        if "geometry" in c.get("source", "") and c["hand_clear"]:
            c["height"] = 0.085
            res = grasp(c)
            if res["holding_something"]:
                break

if res["holding_something"]:
    # Reorient pen upright above holder
    reorient_held_object_upright(hx, hy, table_z + rim_h + 0.12)
    # Lower pen into holder and release
    move_by(dz=-0.08)
    open_gripper()
    retreat(0.15)
    go_home()

check("cyan_pen", "magenta_holder")
